## Module checklist

- [ ] API payloads, URLs, business behavior, and permissions are unchanged unless documented.
- [ ] Form schema is co-located; RHF fields and shared form layout follow `docs/UI_STANDARDS.md`.
- [ ] Lists use the shared filters, chips, `CommonTable`, loading/error/empty states, and mobile cards.
- [ ] Mutations show API messages and invalidate React Query keys; destructive actions use confirmation.
- [ ] Permission checks cover route, sidebar, create/edit/delete, bulk, and export actions.
- [ ] Added/updated tests cover the affected form, list, errors, permissions, and keyboard access.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run check:ui`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] Responsive and light/dark checks completed at 360/768/1024/1440; keyboard and axe checks completed.
- [ ] For API changes: lint, typecheck, tests, build, migration/seed checks, and relevant smoke flow pass.
